subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should Control UI theming remain Claw/Knot/Dash plus one browser-local tweakcn import slot, or should OpenClaw sponsor a built-in preset gallery and custom theme studio with broader persistence?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally expose a narrower import-slot model, while this issue requests a new in-product authoring and persistence surface that code inspection cannot approve as product direction.

options.title: Define a narrow core theming roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, editor, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

options.title: Keep tweakcn-only in core
options.body: Document the current external editor plus import-slot path as the supported customization model, then close or narrow the larger studio request after preserving the feedback.

options.title: Split staged theme work
options.body: Track interactive preview, gateway-backed persistence, accessibility presets, and local override editing as separate product-approved slices.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow core theming roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, editor, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is the live assignee and has the closest direct history on recent Appearance/theme polish through PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/49436.
